	audio_parameter = mena
	parameters = {
	}
	is_shown = {
		heritage_is_shown_trigger = { HERITAGE = honniasont_culture_group }
	}
}

eu5_heritage_honniasont_culture_group = {
	type = language
	is_shown = {
		language_is_shown_trigger = { LANGUAGE = eu5_heritage_honniasont_culture_group }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 10
		if = {
			limit = { has_cultural_pillar = eu5_heritage_honniasont_culture_group }
			multiply = 10
		}
	}
}
